config.Description:
Config for the module. For the resident module, its config value is defined at this level.
For the inherited module, its config value is inherited from the ancestor module.

display_name.Description: The human readable name to be displayed for the module.

enablement_state.Description: The state of enablement for the module at the given level of the hierarchy. Possible values: ["ENABLED", "DISABLED"]

last_editor.Description: The editor that last updated the custom module

name.Description:
The resource name of the Event Threat Detection custom module.
Its format is "organizations/{organization}/eventThreatDetectionSettings/customModules/{module}".

organization.Description: Numerical ID of the parent organization.

type.Description: Immutable. Type for the module. e.g. CONFIGURABLE_BAD_IP.

update_time.Description:
The time at which the custom module was last updated.

A timestamp in RFC3339 UTC "Zulu" format, with nanosecond resolution and
up to nine fractional digits. Examples: "2014-10-02T15:01:23Z" and "2014-10-02T15:01:23.045123456Z".
